candidate.title: scM&T-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina scM&T-seq schematic, resolved to the Angermueller bead-based separation of single-cell poly(A) RNA and genomic DNA, followed by upper Smart-seq2 and lower scBS-seq branches. The card capitalization scM&T-Seq and figure/primary spelling scM&T-seq refer to this target. Smart-seq2 and scBS-seq are embedded components, and G&T-seq is separation context rather than a depicted alternative. The matching RNA catalogue page has the same heading and schematic caption; its related Hu scMT-seq/scRRBS workflow is unshown background. The far-left Single cell RNA/DNA vignette identifies paired analytes rather than an additional processing branch. Shared Sequence and Align RNA and methylome captions are represented by separate branch-specific operation instances, with common source-cell association and no inferred material pooling or cross-molecule alignment.
